mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust economic output, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO increases (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annually), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as growth concerns emerge.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS declines in late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in payroll employment (UNRATE and PAYEMS) indicates severe labor market deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).
